name: Soft cleaning cloth
descriptions: A soft cloth, made out of silk.
Leaves no fabric fibers behind.

name: Window curtains
descriptions: Large curtains, made out of cotton.
White in color

name: Oiler Set
descriptions: A set of tools for oiling mechanisms.
Includes a small bottle of oil and a pump-action applicator.
Used for oiling clockwork mechanisms.

name: Kerosene container
descriptions: A container for kerosene. It is a large rectangular can, dull orange color.
It is full of kerosene. Will fill half of the IOV kerosene tank.
The liquid inside is dark and oily. It has a strong odor.

name: IOV Mantle
descriptions: A mantle for the IOV lamp.
A soft silk mesh, white in color.
Some say it is radioactive. It has no specific odor to it.

name: IOV Spirit Pan
descriptions: A pan for spirit. It's circular shape holds a bit of spirit.
With a nice handle to hold it by.
A brass color, small enough to handle with one hand.

name: Denatured alcohol barrel
descriptions: A small carryable barrel for denatured alcohol.
Helpful for carrying small amounts of denatured alcohol.
The tiny oak barrel, dark in color and, the spirit is trapped by a dense cork with a dark resinous texture.

name: Set of matches
descriptions: A box of matches.
A small box of matches, with a striking surface on the side.
